financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants (closing expected June 16, 2023)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The aggregate net proceeds to us from the offering are expected to be approximately $93.6 million, after deducting the underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us

warrants.quote: warrants to purchase up to (i) 33,988 shares of our common stock at an exercise price of $3.31 per share
(ii) 26,078 shares of our common stock at an exercise price of $14.38 per share were outstanding as of March 31, 2023.
